$comment: What happens when a need runs out (D-080). Each need has one rule at 0: "pass_out" (you collapse where you are and come to after pass_out.hours, energy back to energy_after; outdoors someone may go through your pockets), "hospital" (you pass out and an ambulance takes you to the hospital: kept there for hours, billed bill_cents by it, needs set to after when you leave), "accident" (bladder only: wetting yourself, data/society/details.json) or "notice" (you're told once; while it stays at 0 its emotions_per_hour and needs_per_hour run, people warm to you receptivity times as much, and condition, if named, comes on). A need counts as hitting 0 again only after it has been back above rearm_above. Every time counts toward the conditions in zero_conditions.json (from_zero). summary is what the needs card says; text is what you're told when it happens. {hospital}, {hours} and {bill} are filled in; {where} is " at <place>" or " in the street".

needs.summary: You pass out where you stand and lose about {hours} hours. Out in the street, someone may go through your pockets.
needs.text: You ran out of energy and passed out{where}.

needs.summary: You pass out from hunger and wake up in {hospital}: kept {hours} hours, billed {bill}.
needs.text: You passed out from hunger. Someone called an ambulance, and you came to on a drip at {hospital}. They're keeping you {hours} hours. Bill: {bill}.

needs.summary: You collapse and an ambulance takes you to {hospital}: kept {hours} hours, billed {bill}.
needs.text: Your body gave out and you collapsed. An ambulance took you to {hospital}. They're keeping you {hours} hours. Bill: {bill}.

needs.summary: You wet yourself. Anyone who sees it remembers, and tells their friends.
You smell: people warm to you far less, and you catch the flu more easily, until you wash.
needs.text: Hygiene is at 0: you smell, and people are keeping their distance. A shower fixes it.

needs.summary: Loneliness and sadness climb every hour until you spend time with people.
needs.text: Social is at 0: you feel cut off from everyone. Talk to someone, or go where people are.

needs.summary: Stress climbs and happiness drains every hour until you do something fun.
needs.text: Recreation is at 0: everything feels like a chore. Do something fun.

needs.summary: Everything aches: stress climbs and you tire faster until you sit or lie somewhere comfortable.
needs.text: Comfort is at 0: everything aches. Sit or lie down somewhere comfortable.

needs.summary: You look a mess: confidence drops every hour and first impressions suffer until you freshen up.
needs.text: Grooming is at 0: you look a mess, and you know it. Freshen up.

needs.summary: You get a toothache that stays until a dentist treats it.
needs.text: Dental is at 0, and now you have a toothache. The clinic's dentist can fix it.
